snippet.title: Aftertaste - Official Gameplay Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026
snippet.description: Aftertaste is a 2.5D indie platformer game where you play as Tami, the tongue of a burned-out chef, Keh, and rediscover her lost passion. Let’s embark on a journey of regaining her taste through adventure and puzzles. The new Aftertaste trailer showcases gameplay. Aftertaste will be available on Steam.
